title: Position of Adverbs
theory:
 Adverbs are placed in a sentence according to their type (manner, place, time, frequency,
 degree) to show how, where, when, how often, or to what extent an action happens.

 1 Adverb of Manner – (Politely, well, carefully)
 Subject + Verb + Object + Adverb of Manner

 2 Adverb of Place – (Here, there, Abroad)
 Subject + Verb + Object + Adverb of Place

 3 Adverb of Time – (Tomorrow, yesterday, today)
 Subject + Verb + Object + Adverb of Time

 Note
 If all the three come in a sentence, follow the order:
 Subject + Verb + Object + Adverb of Manner + Adverb of Place + Adverb of Time

 4 Adverb of Frequency – (Always, often, never)
 Subject + Helping Verb + Adverb of Frequency + Main Verb + Object

 5 Adverb of Degree – (Very, too, almost)
 Before the Adjective / Verb / Adverb it modifies.

 Note

 Adverbs like only, even, and just are used before the word they modify
